name: Gajanan Securities Services Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Gajanan Securities Services Ltd is engaged in investing and 
dealing in securities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GSSL operates in the domestic financial markets. It is in the business of trading in shares, securities, and derivatives.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.14 times its book value
Promoter holding has increased by 4.38% over last quarter.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.50% over last 3 years.
